title: Antique Mall Near Minden & Gardnerville, NV | Up US-395
description: Northern Nevada's largest antique mall is 16–18 miles up US-395 from Minden and Gardnerville. Open every day 10–6, with a scenic way home via Genoa.

hero.h1: Antiques near Minden & Gardnerville, worth the drive up US-395
hero.lede: Northern Nevada's largest antique mall is 16 to 18 miles north of Minden and Gardnerville, about 30–35 minutes up US-395 to North Carson Street. Over 21,000 square feet of vendor booths on two floors, open every day from 10 to 6.

photo.alt: A tall wooden hutch in a vendor booth, its glass doors open on shelves of dolls, plush bunnies and a birdhouse, with baskets, linens and jars on the shelves below
photo.caption: One Furniture booth, one tall hutch, on our last look.

route.note: Not to scale. Drawn via Carson Street through downtown; your map may take the freeway instead. The Valley to our door: 16–18 mi, about 30–35 min.

sources: Drive miles and times (Minden 16 mi, Gardnerville 17–18 mi, 16–18 mi / about 30–35 min via US-395): the homepage's DIST table (index.html, #getting-here comment). Never recomputed here.

Hours, address, parking lot, 21,000 sq ft on two floors, upstairs, cashier at the entrance, numbered booths by different vendors, store items (hand planes, railroad lantern, oil lamps, carved wooden boots, oak wall telephone, baskets, linens, Wells Fargo & Co. Express sign, street signs, the hutch): brand.md + store photos, as on the homepage.
Brady T. quote: Google review, quoted verbatim on the homepage.

Carson Street.

https://router.project-osrm.org route steps (2026-10-19) — Gardnerville Main Street carries US 395; order Genoa Lane, Genoa Main Street, Jacks Valley Road, US 395 (road names and order only, no distances used).
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nevada_State_Route_206 — Genoa Lane is SR 206 and meets US 395 west of Minden–Tahoe Airport.

https://www.aaroads.com/guides/nv-206 — Jacks Valley Road removed from SR 206 ca. 1996, now county-maintained; runs north through northwestern Carson Valley across the Jacks Valley Wildlife Management Area to US 395 south of Carson City.

https://parks.nv.gov/parks/mormon-station — site of Nevada's first permanent, non-native settlement; built 1851 as a trading post on the Carson Route of the California Trail; reconstruction of the original that burned in 1910; museum of original pioneer artifacts; 2295 Main Street, Genoa; museum seasonal.

https://ww2.aaa.com/roadtrips/pacific-southwest/carson-valley-scenic-drive-road-trip-AA463 — Carson Valley Scenic Drive follows SR 206 (Jacks Valley Road / Main Street / Foothill Road); Sierra Nevada dominates the horizon; fenced-in ranches and open land; Courthouse Museum and Mormon Station directly across the street.
https://dangberg.org/?p=18 — H.F. Dangberg came west in 1853, built a log cabin, cleared and irrigated his claim; the ranch grew to almost 50,000 acres of cattle and sheep.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minden,_Nevada — Minden built on company land of the Dangberg Home Ranch.

close.h2: Up 395 to the yellow sign on North Carson Street
close.body: 1831 N Carson St, Carson City: 16 to 18 miles from the Valley, with a parking lot right out front. The cashier's at the entrance, and the booths go on from there.
